answer: By the nebula of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Work waits on the shale until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the yarrow of the next round. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
